## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Failure-report selection should be fixed because dot-prefixed paths are silently omitted from matching requests.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from failure reports, refactors cached selection without changing its behavior, and adds selector tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching requests — For `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, this returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. Unlike `select_explicit`, the new selector compares unnormalized paths. — When reports use `./` prefixes, users lose matching failed tests from the selected rerun set. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` with `requested` while returning the original `path`.
